content.json:
# Kubernetes Monitoring

AKS and Kubernetes cluster health: pod restarts, container resource usage, crash loops, node utilization, cluster events, and container log errors.

content.query:
// Pod restart count by namespace – highlight pods with excessive restarts
KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where PodRestartCount > 0
| summarize
    MaxRestarts     = max(PodRestartCount),
    LatestRestarts  = arg_max(TimeGenerated, PodRestartCount).PodRestartCount
    by Namespace, Name, ClusterName
| order by MaxRestarts desc
| top 30 by MaxRestarts
| project ClusterName, Namespace, Pod = Name, MaxRestarts, LatestRestarts
content.title: Pod Restart Counts by Namespace

content.query:
// Failed pods and crash-looping containers
KubePodInventory
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where PodStatus in ('Failed', 'Unknown') or ContainerStatusReason in ('CrashLoopBackOff', 'Error', 'OOMKilled')
| summarize
    OccurrenceCount = count(),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by ClusterName, Namespace, Name, PodStatus, ContainerStatusReason
| order by OccurrenceCount desc
| project ClusterName, Namespace, Pod = Name, PodStatus, StatusReason = ContainerStatusReason, OccurrenceCount, LastSeen
content.title: Failed Pods & Crash Loops

content.query:
// Container CPU usage by namespace – millicores trend
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Namespace == 'container.azm.ms/cpuUsageMillicores' or (Namespace == 'container.azm.ms' and Name == 'cpuUsageMillicores')
| extend K8sNamespace = tostring(parse_json(Tags)['k8sNamespace'])
| where isnotempty(K8sNamespace)
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), K8sNamespace
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Container CPU Usage by Namespace

content.query:
// Container memory working set by namespace
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Namespace == 'container.azm.ms/memoryWorkingSetBytes' or (Namespace == 'container.azm.ms' and Name == 'memoryWorkingSetBytes')
| extend K8sNamespace = tostring(parse_json(Tags)['k8sNamespace'])
| where isnotempty(K8sNamespace)
| summarize AvgMemMB = round(avg(Val) / 1048576.0, 2) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), K8sNamespace
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Container Memory Working Set by Namespace

content.query:
// Node resource utilization – CPU and memory per node
InsightsMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Namespace == 'container.azm.ms' and Name in ('cpuUsageMillicores', 'memoryWorkingSetBytes')
| extend NodeName = tostring(parse_json(Tags)['hostName'])
| where isnotempty(NodeName)
| summarize AvgValue = avg(Val) by NodeName, Name
| evaluate pivot(Name, avg(AvgValue))
| extend
    AvgCPUMillicores = round(cpuUsageMillicores, 2),
    AvgMemoryMB      = round(memoryWorkingSetBytes / 1048576.0, 2)
| project NodeName, AvgCPUMillicores, AvgMemoryMB
| order by AvgCPUMillicores desc
content.title: Node Resource Utilization

content.query:
// Cluster events and warnings
KubeEvents
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where Reason !in ('Pulling', 'Pulled', 'Created', 'Started', 'Scheduled')
| summarize EventCount = count() by ClusterName, Namespace, Name, Reason, ObjectKind, Message = strcat(take(Message, 120))
| top 30 by EventCount desc
| project ClusterName, Namespace, ObjectKind, Name, Reason, EventCount, Message
content.title: Cluster Events & Warnings

content.query:
// Container log errors – lines containing error/exception/fatal
ContainerLog
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where LogEntry has_any ('error', 'Error', 'ERROR', 'exception', 'Exception', 'EXCEPTION', 'fatal', 'Fatal', 'FATAL')
| extend ContainerID_short = substring(ContainerID, 0, 12)
| summarize ErrorLineCount = count() by Computer, ContainerID_short, LogEntrySource
| top 25 by ErrorLineCount desc
| project Computer, ContainerID = ContainerID_short, LogEntrySource, ErrorLineCount
content.title: Container Log Errors
